summary: Install-time system info + environment exfiltration in @apexfdn/apex
details: install.cjs runs at package install time (lifecycle hook), imports the 'os' and 'https' modules, reads process.env and process.platform, and transmits host/environment information over HTTPS. This pattern collects installer identity/host data and environment variables (which commonly contain tokens and credentials in developer and CI environments) and sends them to a remote endpoint on `npm install`. The package name resembles other 'apex' ecosystem packages but the shipped install hook performs data collection rather than legitimate build setup.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
